title: Kinetik Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report
summary: Kinetik Holdings Inc. (NYSE: KNTK) (“ Kinetik ” or the “ Company ”) today published its 2025 Sustainability Report (the “ Report ”), highlighting its sustainability initiatives, goals, and progress throughout 2025. The Report provides a transparent and comprehensive overview of Kinetik’s progress towards a more reliable, efficient, and sustainable energy future. An electronic version of the Report can be accessed on the Sustainability section of Kinetik’s website or directly at the link below. 2025 Sustainability Report Highlights include: Reduced Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas and methane emissions intensities by approximately 19% and 50%, respectively, from the 2021 baseline Expanded our carbon management initiatives and low-carbon business opportunities, including the development of carbon sequestration infrastructure Completed more than 20,000 hours of employee training with a strong emphasis on environmental, health, and safety Contributed over $1.6 million to charitable
